# CityMETER · Housing Estate

> Allocated plots the Department of Lands (DOL) website allocation records report, per production district and province across Thailand (the CityMETER production estate layer, ?d=estate), with the housing estate projects the research team collected from developers' own catalogues: reference pins, approximate extents from OpenStreetMap with the buildings inside lit in 3D, labels and starting prices as the pages showed them, the launch the research team found, legal entities and parents from notices and company reports, the DOL records paired with each project, and straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit). A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.1.2 (2026-11-18), Thai with an English reading (?lang=en). Research master read and built 2026-11-18.

What one figure means:
- record (รายการ) = one DOL website allocation record of the CityMETER production snapshot (19,753). A registration, not a village: one estate can hold several records (phases). Records are never merged and carry no point.
- allocated plots (แปลงจัดสรร) = the plots a record reports, summed per district and province where the record's plots by type add up to its total (2,689,640; production's raw total 2,689,950). Not finished houses, households, residents, sales or a market size.
- plot types = detached house, semi-detached house, row house/townhome, shophouse, vacant plot, other, as the record reports them; house plots = the first three (2,335,133).
- areas = the production district and province each record is counted in (395 districts, 77 provinces): a query boundary, not an address.
- project (โครงการ) = one entry of a developer's catalogue the research team collected (1,538 from 65 publishers); 798 have a reference pin from the publisher's own evidence (Google Maps coordinates never used: 58 stay off the map). A project carries no plots.
- pair = a project and a DOL record the research team paired, named by how (confirmed, name+developer+address, name+parcel, name+publisher); 373 shown, held pairs out.
- extent = an OpenStreetMap residential area named as the project and holding its pin (or within 30 m), approximate (“about N rai” = m² ÷ 1,600); 139. Not a deed or a legal boundary.
- labels, prices, launches = what the page showed when the research team read it; never a sales status, a price comparison or a permit date.
- allocator = named only when the name carries a legal-entity form.
- distances = straight lines between reference points; not walking routes, travel times or catchments.

Snapshot (release 0.2.0; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 46% of the allocated plots nationwide (1,236,824 of 2,689,640) are in Bangkok, Pathum Thani and Chon Buri; among house plots only, 47% (1,101,249 of 2,335,133).
- Records: Bangkok 3,767, Chon Buri 2,849, Pathum Thani 1,294 — 40% of 19,753.
- In Bangkok, 24% of the plots (127,566 of 539,167) are in Bang Khun Thian, Prawet and Sai Mai; in Chiang Mai, 66% in Mueang Chiang Mai, San Sai and San Kamphaeng.

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/housingestate/):
- ?d=estate&at={province} — e.g. BKK, CMI, PTE (production codes) · ?d=estate&at={province}/D/{district} — e.g. BKK/D/1012
- ?e=site:{project key} · ?e=record:{18-digit DOL website id} · ?e=station:{CityMETER Transit station id} · ?n=company:{publisher key}
- ?m=records — measure records instead of plots · ?f.type={detached|twin|row|commercial|land|other} · ?f.house={detached|semi_detached|townhouse|mixed_low_rise|low_rise_unspecified|shophouse|home_office} · ?f.search={text}
- ?view={provinces|types|districts} — chart view · ?v3d=0 — plan view · ?lang=en — English

Files: data/estates.json (first paint) · data/extents.json · data/portfolio.json · data/records.json (after the first paint) · data/record-points.json (each record at the point CityMETER production draws for it, after the records) · DATA_METHOD.md (method and limits) · PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md (Thai) · AGENTS.md (contract) · handoff/ (developer handoff)
